8bda1069-7ead-4e2a-b611-66bf829e8efe.text: Also today: I **proved** WOW 894 (the last conjecture in the corpus) rather than refuting it. "Cubic triangle-free ⇒ blue independence ≤ 2·girth" is a theorem: blue independence is ≤10 always, and a set of 9 mutually-within-distance-2 vertices forces the graph to *be* the Petersen graph — the only alternative case needs a 9-vertex triangle-free diameter-2 graph with degrees (3⁸,2), and `nauty-geng` shows the four candidates all fail. Equality holds exactly for girth-4 graphs with blue independence 8 (e.g. the Wagner graph) and for Petersen. Proof committed at `notes/WOW894_is_true.md`.
